title: This week in India's growth story.
caption:
This week in India's growth story: 15 stories covering history, sectors and mindset.

1. She was born in Kerala. On November 3, 2026, she was elected the first South Asian woman to lead Los Angeles.
2. She started making ice cream at home during the 2020 lockdown. By 2026, her business crossed Rs 30 lakh a year.
3. On this day, India got its 27th state - and it took seven more years to get its own name back.
4. India's services sector just hit a 4-month high. And input costs just hit a 6-year low.
5. India's exports just jumped 23% in a single month - against the same month last year.
6. His parents immigrated from India to Georgia. On November 3, 2026, he became the first Sikh ever elected to its state legislature.
7. He passed the toughest exam of the British Raj - then got dismissed on a technicality. It made him a founder of Indian politics.
8. He became Congress president at 35 - then spent over a decade building the system that still educates India today.
9. A month after crossing 800 million transactions a day, UPI just broke its own record again. This time, the average day crossed Rs 1 lakh crore.
10. A Gujarat port just broke its own fastest-ever record. By breaking it even faster than before.
11. He founded a university that still runs today. Decades later, India gave him its highest civilian honor - after he was gone.
12. A 12-year-old inherited a small chiefdom. By the time he was done, he ruled an empire that stretched from Kabul to Tibet.
13. He was born and educated in India. Now he runs one of the world's biggest beer companies.
14. He spent his life reading the story written in stone - fossilized plants that proved India's past stretched back hundreds of millions of years.
15. He led a tribal uprising against colonial exploitation. India now marks his birthday as a national day of pride.
